svg.text: EXPERIENCE: FROM A KILL TO A NEW LEVEL
The test is experience[slot] > table[levels[slot]]: strictly greater, and only one level per award. A table entry of FFFFFFFF ends advancement.
GEXPTABLES: EXPERIENCE NEEDED FOR EACH LEVEL (LOG SCALE), ONE TABLE PER BASE CLASS
5000 XP at creation, divided by the number of classes
dots: the level reached when the total passes the mark
